name: Configurable snapping and a grid with adjustable size
body:
# Snapping and grid

Snap steps (translate, rotate, scale) are editable in Settings and shown in the toolbar; the grid's minor step and
major-line interval follow the translate step; a View toggle hides the grid. Holding Shift while dragging temporarily
inverts snapping. Settings persist in the editor settings file.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. Snap steps per tool (lantern_editor_set_snap_step), grid spacing as a view option, both in Settings > Snapping and Viewport and saved in preferences.
